description: Diabetes laboratory frequency and medical-necessity rules from Daman's public guideline (ref 2013-MN-0012 v3.1). Applied to SEAL's fictional insurers.

rules.title: HbA1c repeated within 3 months
rules.insurerNeeds: No HbA1c result in the past 3 months, or a documented reason to repeat it early.
fixTemplates: HbA1c repeated before 3 months because ____ (last result ____ on ____).
Last HbA1c on ____ is not available to this clinic because ____.

source.title: Diabetes Mellitus Lab Tests Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: A1C, if the results are not available within the past 3 months — Every 3 months — Any diabetes. … MNEC-005 Service /supply may be appropriate, but too frequent

rules.title: C-peptide, insulin, proinsulin or insulin antibodies for diabetes
rules.insurerNeeds: These tests are not considered medically necessary for screening, diagnosing or monitoring type 1, type 2 or gestational diabetes. A separate, documented indication outside diabetes care is needed.
fixTemplates: Test ordered for ____ (indication other than diabetes screening, diagnosis or monitoring).

source.title: Diabetes Mellitus Lab Tests Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: the following tests are not considered medically necessary for the screening, diagnosis or monitoring of Type 1 DM, Type 2 DM and GDM: genetic markers, insulin, proinsulin, C-peptide and insulin antibodies.

rules.notes: Guideline lists MNEC-004 among its denial codes; the scenario S2 C-peptide line maps here.

rules.title: Lipid profile in diabetes more than once a year
rules.insurerNeeds: Lipids are covered annually in diabetes, or after starting or changing diabetes, blood-pressure, cholesterol or thyroid medicines.
fixTemplates: Lipid profile repeated after ____ (medicine) was started / dose changed on ____.

source.title: Diabetes Mellitus Lab Tests Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: Lipid profile, including total, LDL, and HDL cholesterol and triglycerides — Annually (and after initiation/dose changes of diabetes medications, blood pressure medications, cholesterol medications, or thyroid medications)

rules.title: Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio more than once a year
rules.insurerNeeds: Spot urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio is covered once a year in diabetes.
fixTemplates: Urine ACR repeated within the year because ____.

source.title: Diabetes Mellitus Lab Tests Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: Spot urinary albumin-to creatinine ratio — Annually — Any diabetes

rules.notes: Exclusion for kidney-related diabetes codes is SEAL's reading of 'more frequently if with CKD' stated for serum creatinine; treat as an assumption.

rules.title: Routine TSH in type 2 diabetes without a thyroid indication
rules.insurerNeeds: Annual TSH is listed for type 1 diabetes. In type 2 diabetes the note needs a thyroid sign, symptom or diagnosis.

source.title: Diabetes Mellitus Lab Tests Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: Thyroid-stimulating hormone in patients with type 1 diabetes — Annually … — DM Type 1. Daman does not cover investigations outside best practice recommendations.

rules.notes: The guideline lists TSH only for type 1; applying it as a refusal risk for type 2 is SEAL's reading of 'outside best practice'.

rules.title: Vitamin B12 on metformin without neurological signs
rules.insurerNeeds: B12 is covered on metformin when the patient has neurological manifestations and long-term use.

source.title: Diabetes Mellitus Lab Tests Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: Vitamin B12 if on metformin (when indicated) — When indicated (if patient has neuro manifestations and long-term use)

rules.title: HbA1c by home-use device
rules.insurerNeeds: HbA1c by a device cleared for home use is not covered.

source.title: Diabetes Mellitus Lab Tests Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: CPT Haemoglobin: glycosylated (A1C) by device cleared by FDA for home use is not covered, as there is still insufficient evidence recommending its use.

rules.title: Diabetes tests for an asymptomatic patient without a screening benefit
rules.insurerNeeds: Symptoms suggesting diabetes (for example polyuria, polydipsia), a screening indication listed by the insurer, or a health-screening benefit on the plan.

source.title: Diabetes Mellitus Lab Tests Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: Daman does not cover investigations for asymptomatic patients, unless recommended by the regulator or if with routine medical check-up benefit/ health screening benefit.
